subject: Reinvigorating Democracy Campaign Appeal
overview: Candidate Anna Callahan reflected on restoring faith in electoral politics and solicited campaign donations while sharing a chapter from her draft book on democracy.

items.title: Campaign Statement on Democracy
items.summary: Anna Callahan shared an anecdote about restoring a disillusioned donor's faith in electoral politics through an excerpt of her draft book and invited viewers to read the chapter and contribute to her Medford campaign.
